description:
Apple Intelligence brings powerful generative models to hundreds of millions of people, on device and in the cloud, with an uncompromising commitment to privacy. Delivering these experiences responsibly takes infrastructure that is as reliable and rigorous as the models it supports. We are looking for people who want to help build it.

The Creative Intelligence & Aesthetics team sits at the epicenter of Apple's GenAI infrastructure and safety efforts. We build the platforms, pipelines, and tooling that let researchers and engineers train, evaluate, and safeguard Apple's foundation models at scale. Our work directly shapes how quickly and how safely new GenAI features reach customers. If you're passionate about building ML systems that are correct, scalable, and trustworthy, we would like to hear from you.


Description
You will design, build, and maintain the infrastructure that powers Apple's GenAI model development and safety efforts. This includes scalable pipelines for data processing, large-scale model evaluation, safety and red-teaming workflows, and the tooling that researchers rely on every day. You will partner closely with ML researchers, safety specialists, and product teams to understand their needs and turn them into robust, well-engineered systems. You will be responsible for the reliability, reproducibility, and efficiency of these systems, and you will continuously look for ways to improve them. You should stay up to date with the latest developments in ML infrastructure and generative AI, both in academia and in industry, and be able to apply that knowledge to influence Apple's products.


Minimum qualifications
3+ years of experience building and operating infrastructure for machine learning, such as training, evaluation, data processing, or inference systems.
Strong programming skills in Python, along with experience in software engineering best practices (testing, code review, CI/CD).
Hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.
Experience with distributed computing and cloud-native technologies.
Exceptional attention to detail: you take pride in getting things right, and you know that small errors in data, metrics, or pipelines can have outsized consequences.
Self-motivated, with the ability to take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them to completion with minimal direction.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Ability to work hands-on in multi-functional teams.


Preferred qualifications
Experience with large language model training, evaluation, or inference stacks is a plus.
Familiarity with AI safety, responsible AI, or model evaluation methodologies would be a plus.
Experience with workflow orchestration, experiment tracking, or large-scale data pipelines would be a plus.
A background in statistics or experimental design would be a plus.
BS, MS, or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
